title: Xuân muộn
about: Round 27, ke-chuyen ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác"), spring in the album of a year's waiting, a late one: D Dorian at 76 bpm, the brightest of the set, its B natural (Dm6, G major) a little hope inside the minor. Its motif steps down the chord and leaps a sixth to that B (F-D-B), then falls back over Am7. The piano first; then the violas sing the tune an octave lower while the piano plays soft waltz-like chords under them (texture sparse); the climax in F major with the strings and the piano's rolled chords, E6 at its top and B5 held over G; the piano again with the cellos' second line and the violas at the sentences' ends, ending on Dm6, the Dorian chord. An original tune. Round 28 ("tôi muốn các bài sẽ có không gian giống ambient hơn, tiếng piano mờ ảo hơn, nhạc dễ ngủ hơn"): on ke-chuyen-mo, a hall nearly twice as long, the piano softer and hazier, 67 bpm (was 76), every section softer and the climax low, sparse chords for the rolled ones, the plucked cellos and the octaves left out. Round 29 ("tôi thấy không gian ambient đã ổn nhưng muốn tiếng piano gần tai hơn, độ vang và tiếng giống tiếng piano relax hơn"): on ke-chuyen-relax, the same hall, the piano nearer, clearer and less of the Rhodes under it.
